restaurant

American
[res-tuh-rahnt, -trahnt] /ˈrɛs təˌrɑnt, -trɑnt/

noun
an establishment where meals are served to customers.

British
/ˈrɛstrɒŋ, -rɒnt, ˈrɛstəˌrɒŋ/

noun
a commercial establishment where meals are prepared and served to customers

Etymology
Origin of restaurant

An Americanism first recorded in 1820–30; from French, noun use of present participle of restaurer, from Latin restaurāre “to restore, reestablish”; re- (def.), store

bistro vs. restaurant

ground_truth.main_content_markdown:
# restaurant

*American*
[**res**-t*uh*-rahnt, -trahnt] /ˈrɛs təˌrɑnt, -trɑnt/

## noun
an establishment where meals are served to customers.

*British*
/ˈrɛstrɒŋ, -rɒnt, ˈrɛstəˌrɒŋ/

## noun
a commercial establishment where meals are prepared and served to customers

## Etymology
Origin of *restaurant*

An Americanism first recorded in 1820–30; from French, noun use of present participle of *restaurer,* from Latin *restaurāre* “to restore, reestablish”; [re-](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/re) (def.), [store](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/store)

## Compare meaning
How does *restaurant* compare to similar and commonly confused words? Explore the most common comparisons:

[bistro vs. restaurant](https://www.dictionary.com/compare-words/bistro-vs-restaurant)

## Example Sentences

> Even if businesses want to hire, the pickings are slimmer, especially in low-skill occupations at hotels and restaurants. From [MarketWatch](https://www.marketwatch.com/story/dont-bet-on-lots-of-hiring-and-new-jobs-in-2026-or-lots-of-layoffs-either-649737c4)

> As the day wore on, he dropped off more items from hamburger joints, coffee shops, noodle stores and a Middle Eastern restaurant, then more tea, before finally calling it quits at 11:31 p.m. From [The Wall Street Journal](https://www.wsj.com/world/asia/14-hour-shifts-and-1-a-deliverybut-chinas-army-of-gig-workers-keeps-growing-81ce58e4)

> The two grew close, Watson said, recalling fond memories of dinners with him at a local Portuguese restaurant. From [The Wall Street Journal](https://www.wsj.com/us-news/claudio-neves-valente-brown-mit-shooter-nuno-loureiro-efd84bd3)

> Rising from the former central post office, the Post Tower will soon open with shops, restaurants and a Kimpton hotel. From [The Wall Street Journal](https://www.wsj.com/lifestyle/travel/best-travel-destinations-vacation-2026-16c79c69)

## Related Words
[bar](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/bar), [cafeteria](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/cafeteria), [coffee shop](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/coffee-shop), [diner](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/diner), [dining room](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/dining-room), [inn](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/inn), [outlet](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/outlet), [saloon](https://www.dictionary.com/browse/saloon)
